input_freeze: func/测试过程/SCFuzzBench公开项目接入/结果/Wallet02Refund/01-input-freeze.json

diagnostic_oracle_isolation.path: func/测试过程/SCFuzzBench公开项目接入/结果/Wallet02Refund/Phase30B-20261119/diagnostic-oracle/

old_planner_control.name: P0-old-planner
old_planner_control.input: Phase30A original Agent A/B candidate, unchanged
old_planner_control.purpose: planner-level Anvil and Echidna replay control; not a parameter-repair comparison

new_planner.name: P1-source-context-planner
new_planner.feedback_pairing: G1 raw and G2 repaired candidates must be parameterizations of the same exact P1 plan with the same transaction function order. If the one permitted repair changes function order or adds/removes a step, retain it as a failed protocol deviation and do not treat it as the G2 parameter-repair comparison.

model.name: deepseek-flash
model.other_parameters: Same defaults and JSON/schema settings as Phase30A; no increase to request count, token budget, or wall budget.

execution_environment.balance_rationale: Use the post-Phase30A environment amendment uniformly to avoid classifying RPC insufficient-funds errors as argument-constraint failures.

verification_gates: Replay the Phase30A P0 original candidate in Anvil with the uniform 100 ETH funding profile.
Generate only one P1 plan, one Agent B instantiation, and at most one same-plan Agent B execution-feedback repair.
Replay P1 raw and, if produced, P1 repaired candidates in Anvil; only a successful state trajectory whose original property evaluates false counts as reaching the target.
Replay the same full P1 candidate through Echidna from an isolated one-seed corpus and require the property failure to be reported for the same sequence.
Do not count Sequence replayed, successful transactions, or mutation_evidence as target attainment.
If P1 produces no target-reaching candidate that Echidna can replay, stop. Do not run G0/G1/G2 fuzzing, make no second algorithm change, and retain all negative results.

conditional_fuzz_comparison.gate: Run only if P1 reaches the target in Anvil and the exact same candidate is confirmed by Echidna.

groups.G1: P1 original Agent B parameterization, before the single execution-feedback repair.
groups.G2: The same P1 plan after the single execution-feedback repair.

each_group.seed_only_replay: Separate zero-fuzzing seed replay, reported only as replay/target status.
each_group.coverage_gain: Compare final coverage against that run's same-engine seed-only or empty-corpus baseline; store new coverage separately from loaded seed coverage.
each_group.mutation_evidence: Never infer mutation from Sequence replayed, tests denominator, successful EVM calls, or fuzzing transaction counters alone.

conditional_fuzz_comparison.planner_control: P0-old-planner remains a separate planner-level control and is not substituted for G1 or G2.

reporting.wallet_sample_classification: mechanism validation only; not an independent held-out result
